selection_basis: Investigability among retained leads, not calibrated fraud probability or a nationwide ranking

decisions.hypothesis: A materially cheaper equivalent commercial item was available
decisions.new_evidence: Lower posted carton price and explicit pack quantity acquired; shared commercial reference identified
decisions.blocking_evidence: Authoritative NSN/product and applicable technical-term match plus dated feasible supply
decisions.disconfirmation: Different required grade, finish, revision or material condition closes this proposed retailer comparison

decisions.hypothesis: Buyer knowingly selected a higher-priced offer improperly
decisions.new_evidence: Original RFQ/award links and H06 governing rule, not actual bids or evaluation
decisions.blocking_evidence: Actual competing quotes and documented evaluation/selection rationale
decisions.disconfirmation: Equivalent bid was not feasible, or supported procurement terms and a valid decision explain selection

decisions.hypothesis: A recurring concealed 12 percent arrangement exists
decisions.new_evidence: No qualified repeated price pairs or personal-benefit records
decisions.blocking_evidence: Independent comparable repeated purchases plus separately supported influence or benefit
decisions.disconfirmation: The user-described rate is an example, not a target to fit the observations to

decisions.hypothesis: The government already lost the apparent retail-price difference
decisions.new_evidence: The retained current line is ordered value with a future delivery date; payment is unverified
decisions.blocking_evidence: Qualified valuation and actual net payment, receipt, credits and remedy scope
decisions.disconfirmation: Unpaid/cancelled/refunded obligations or legitimate term differences invalidate a cash-loss inference

decisions.hypothesis: This is a previously unknown fraud case
decisions.new_evidence: Two bounded exact-identifier searches returned procurement listings, not an acquired official case match
decisions.blocking_evidence: No search can establish government ignorance; no fraud determination has been made
decisions.disconfirmation: An existing disclosure or proceeding defeats a new-discovery description; absence of a search hit proves neither originality nor wrongdoing

next_priority: Exact releasable technical package or actual bid/evaluation record; do not repeat broad seller searches without a new discriminating source
